item.title: Weather It Matters: Risks of icy social media pictures
item.description: ST. JOSEPH, Mich. -- Some might mistake Saint Joseph for Siberia these days. The icy landscape is a quiet contrast to normal noisy waves in the summer.

item.title: Counterfeit 100-dollar bills being passed
item.description: BOURBON, Ind. -- Beware of bogus 100-dollar bills being circulated in Marshall County.

item.title: Diving into Valentine’s Day spending and chocolate prices
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- According to the NRF, Valentine’s Day spending is expected to reach a new record this year, with consumers expected to spend more than $29 billion.

item.title: County says there are no plans for a data center in North Liberty despite speculation
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- Talk of another massive data center coming to Saint Joseph County is not true, at least for now.

item.title: Local municipalities work to save operations budget after Senate Enrolled Act One passed
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. — Local governments, including the City of Mishawaka, are working to mitigate the damage they say they'll face with Senate Enrolled Act One or SEA One.

item.title: 29-year-old woman charged with running people over outside of Frank's Place
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Prosecutors charged 29-year-old, Shakura Wells, after they say she ran over several civilians and dragged a woman through the street using her car.

item.title: South Bend schools raise bus driver pay and incentives to address ongoing shortage
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. — Many Michiana school districts are still struggling to hire enough bus drivers, a shortage that began during the COVID-19 pandemic and continues years later.

item.title: Gymtown Food Bank receives $120k grant for cold storage expansion
item.description: ELKHART COUNTY, Ind. -- The Community Foundation of Elkhart County announced it has awarded the Gymtown Food Bank with a $120,000 capital campaign grant to support the nonprofit's cold storage expansion.

item.title: Downtown South Bend hosts First Fridays: Fire and Ice on Feb. 6
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Downtown South Bend is set to host their monthly First Friday: Fire and Ice on Friday, Feb. 6, from 5 p.m. to 9 p.m.

item.title: St. Joseph seeks public input as Paid Parking returns for Summer
item.description: ST. JOSPEH, Mich. -- Free parking remains in place across downtown St. Joseph for now, but city leaders are already planning for the return of paid parking and want residents and business owners to help shape what that program will look like.
